entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This place never fails to amaze me,[n]no matter how many times we come...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Where does this passage even go?[n]It feels as though I'm being sucked[n]inside merely by gazing upon it.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So this is the heart of man...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It is ugly... yet beautiful as well.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That duality is what makes humanity[n]such an interesting subject...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: As you know, I have been confused[n]recently about the reason for my art.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Did I want to be recognized, or did I[n]want to capture pure beauty? Was it[n]due to my talent, or just my upbringing?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...Each answer would seem correct[n]at first, yet only prove itself false[n]upon a more in-depth examination.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: [fName]...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: When my mother was painting[n]the "Sayuri"... what do you think[n]she was thinking about?
Her love for her son.[clr 27]
The pain of separation.
I don't know.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Such love is almost embarrassing to[n]have pointed out to me...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But you are probably right.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: However, I believe that was not the only[n]thing she thought about.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm, now that you mention it, even I feel[n]the sadness of the situation...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It is indeed possible that my ailing[n]mother could sense her imminent death.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: However, I believe that was not the only[n]thing she thought about.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: *chuckle* A fine point.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That is, of course, something only[n]my mother could have known.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: However, I've been thinking...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems the "Sayuri" was meant to[n]impart something to me... and to all[n]others who view it, for that matter.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Love, regret, loneliness,[n]anxiety, calm... and hope.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: All of the emotions my mother felt,[n]conveyed plainly to the viewer.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That is why it has such a profoundly[n]unique impact on those who see it.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: My paintings pale in comparison to such[n]depth of meaning...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: How could I have hoped to convey[n]pure beauty with my limited palette...!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: And yet... that painting has kept[n]me going this whole time.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: During particularly difficult nights,[n]it was there to soothe my sadness.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It acted almost as a ray of light cutting[n]through the somber darkness...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I had wanted to create a similar beacon[n]of hope for others... but it seems I lost[n]sight of that goal.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Look. This world is a dark, unrelenting[n]place, [fName].

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But that is why I am going to wield my[n]brush again... To give hope to all those[n]who see my paintings.
You've really changed, Yusuke.[clr 27]
That's a great idea.
It won't be easy.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes, thanks to you. You chose to help me[n]work through my problems instead of[n]leaving me to my sadness.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You say that as though you had no[n]relation to its inception... but you are[n]the reason for this idea.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It most certainly will not...[n]I hope you look forward to seeing[n]the rebirth of Yusuke Kitagawa.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Now, I will use my art to paint over[n]the blackness of this world.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It shall become a vivid realm,[n]full of hope... I expect it will be[n]a most beautiful sight to behold.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Perhaps you will see it someday,[n][fName]...
I feel like my bond with Yusuke[n]is growing deeper...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm, this radiant light growing within me...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It must be the light of hope.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...I shall paint it.
I can sense Shadows in the area...
We should leave Mementos...
